mapper.select: SELECT id, episode_id, scene_no, scene_title, location, time_of_day, characters, scene_function, estimated_duration, visual_action, narration, dialogue, performance_camera_note, hook, updated_at FROM story_script_scene WHERE episode_id = #{episodeId} ORDER BY scene_no ASC

SELECT id, episode_id, scene_no, scene_title, location, time_of_day, characters, scene_function, estimated_duration, visual_action, narration, dialogue, performance_camera_note, hook, updated_at FROM story_script_scene WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_script_scene (episode_id, scene_no, scene_title, location, time_of_day, characters, scene_function, estimated_duration, visual_action, narration, dialogue, performance_camera_note, hook, updated_at) VALUES (#{episodeId}, #{sceneNo}, #{sceneTitle}, #{location}, #{timeOfDay}, #{characters}, #{sceneFunction}, #{estimatedDuration}, #{visualAction}, #{narration}, #{dialogue}, #{performanceCameraNote}, #{hook}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE story_script_scene SET scene_title = #{sceneTitle}, location = #{location}, time_of_day = #{timeOfDay}, characters = #{characters}, scene_function = #{sceneFunction}, estimated_duration = #{estimatedDuration}, visual_action = #{visualAction}, narration = #{narration}, dialogue = #{dialogue}, performance_camera_note = #{performanceCameraNote}, hook = #{hook}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE story_script_scene SET scene_no = #{sceneNo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
